pageTitle: Semana 3: Mi semana de lluvia en Sevilla
chapterTitle: Mi semana de lluvia en Sevilla

extraLinks.label: 💬 Practica las conversaciones de esta semana →

blocks.en: Hello, my name is Elena.
I am 32 years old.

blocks.es: Esta es mi semana de [[lluvia|lluvia]] en Sevilla.
blocks.en: This is my rainy week in Sevilla.

blocks.es: Vivo en Madrid, pero esta semana trabajo en Sevilla.
blocks.en: I live in Madrid, but this week I am working in Sevilla.
Today is Monday.
It is eight in the morning.
I get my brown bag ready.

blocks.es: Llevo un [[paraguas|paraguas]], un libro y mi móvil.
blocks.en: I take an umbrella, a book, and my phone.
I water my green plant.
I am happy.
I want to see Sevilla in the sun.

blocks.es: Por la tarde llego a Sevilla.
blocks.en: In the afternoon, I arrive in Sevilla.
It's pouring.
The streets are wet.

blocks.es: Abro mi paraguas y camino despacio.
blocks.en: I open my umbrella and walk slowly.
I look for my little flat.
Here it is.
I am a little sad.
I want sun, but today it is raining.
Afterwards, I walk towards the centre.

blocks.es: Llego a una plaza muy grande, con [[arco|arcos]].
blocks.en: I arrive at a very large square with arches.
I stay under the arches.
There are tiles of many colors.
How cool!
The orange trees are wet.
Everything shines a little.

blocks.es: El martes por la mañana llueve otra vez.
blocks.en: On Tuesday morning, it is raining again.
I go to a museum.
Inside, it is dry and quiet.
I look at the paintings slowly.
There are not many people.
I discover Sevilla from the inside.

blocks.es: Por la tarde vuelvo al piso.
blocks.en: In the afternoon, I go back to the flat.

blocks.es: Fuera la lluvia cae y cae.
blocks.en: Outside, the rain falls and falls.

blocks.es: En la cocina preparo una [[sopa_de_verduras|sopa de verduras]].
blocks.en: In the kitchen, I make a vegetable soup.

blocks.es: Oigo la lluvia en la ventana.
blocks.en: I hear the rain on the window.
The house is warm.
I feel good.

blocks.es: El miércoles salgo con el paraguas.
blocks.en: On Wednesday, I go out with the umbrella.
I walk through an old neighbourhood.
The streets are narrow.
There are lots of orange trees.

blocks.es: Las naranjas son muy naranjas bajo la lluvia.
blocks.en: The oranges are very orange in the rain.
I am not so sad now.
I am curious.

blocks.es: El jueves tomo un café en un [[patio|patio]].
blocks.en: On Thursday, I have a coffee on a patio.

blocks.es: El patio tiene un techo en los lados y está abierto en el centro.
blocks.en: The patio has a roof at the sides and it is open in the center.

blocks.es: Me siento bajo el techo, [[a_cubierto|a cubierto]].
blocks.en: I sit under the roof, undercover.

blocks.es: En el centro cae la lluvia sobre un naranjo.
blocks.en: In the center, the rain falls on an orange tree.
The coffee is hot.
I stay for a while.

blocks.es: El viernes por la mañana miro por la ventana.
blocks.en: On Friday morning, I look out of the window.
The clouds open a little.
The sun comes out.
Oh my goodness!

blocks.es: Solo un rato, pero hay sol.
blocks.en: Only for a while, but there is sun.

blocks.es: Cojo mi bolso y salgo rápido.
blocks.en: I take my bag and go out quickly.
I walk beside the river Guadalquivir.

blocks.es: El agua es ancha y tranquila.
blocks.en: The water is wide and calm.

blocks.es: Veo una [[torre|torre]] redonda, de color dorado.
blocks.en: I see a round, golden-colored tower.
It is the Torre del Oro.
The sky is clear, at last.
At last.

blocks.es: Cruzo un [[puente|puente]] y llego a Triana.
blocks.en: I cross a bridge and arrive in Triana.

blocks.es: Me siento un rato junto al río.
blocks.en: I sit for a while by the river.

blocks.es: Siento el sol en la cara.
blocks.en: I feel the sun on my face.
I am calm and happy.

blocks.es: Este rato de sol es especial.
blocks.en: This little while in the sun is special.
On Saturday, it is raining again.

blocks.es: Abro el paraguas, pero ahora sonrío.
blocks.en: I open the umbrella, but now I smile.
I walk without hurry.

blocks.es: Miro los azulejos y los naranjos.
blocks.en: I look at the tiles and the orange trees.

blocks.es: Mis planes cambian y no pasa nada.
blocks.en: My plans change and it's no problem.

blocks.es: El domingo me quedo en el piso.
blocks.en: On Sunday, I stay in the flat.

blocks.es: Me siento junto a la ventana.
blocks.en: I sit by the window.
The rain is soft.
It is not only sad.

blocks.es: Pienso, la lluvia también puede ser bonita.
blocks.en: I think the rain can be beautiful too.

blocks.es: Extraño un poco mi planta verde en Madrid.
blocks.en: I miss my green plant in Madrid a little.

blocks.es: Sevilla ya es un recuerdo tranquilo.
blocks.en: Sevilla is already a calm memory.

blocks.es: Esta es mi semana de lluvia en Sevilla.
blocks.en: This is my rainy week in Sevilla.
